fields.title: 📖 as-Suddī: 5:44 rebukes abandoning Allah’s judgment
fields.body:
🖋️ **as-Suddī:**

> ***“The Āyah warns against abandoning what Allah has sent down, and against judging by other than His judgment.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The verse remains immense and general as a warning. Its application, however, needs the Tafṣīl of the Salaf: denial and replacement are not like sinful deviation while acknowledging.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr und aṭ-Ṭabarī, Tafsīr zu Sūrah al-Māʾidah 5:44.
